description: Implement real dashboard with API integration, trial banner, and functional components
steps: Replace placeholder dashboard in apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx with functional dashboard
Header: Logo from /tood logo png.png, org name from /me endpoint, plan badge, sign out button
Trial banner: Read trial_started from localStorage, show 'X days left in your free trial — Upgrade now' with link to /#pricing, redirect after 14 days
Quick action buttons: '+ New tender' (href='/dashboard/tenders/new'), 'Load sample tender' (POST /api/analyse-sample), 'Add evidence' (href='/dashboard/evidence/new')
Recent tenders list: Fetch GET /api/tenders with Bearer token, show name + created_at, empty state handling
Stats row: Fetch GET /api/evidence and tender count, display counts
Integrate /me endpoint: Fetch user data, handle 401 redirect to /login
Add error handling for network errors and API failures
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows real data from API endpoints (/me, /api/tenders, /api/evidence)
Trial banner shows countdown from localStorage
Quick action buttons work (placeholders okay for new tender/evidence)
Sample tender button calls API and shows notification
All API calls include Authorization: Bearer <token> from sessionStorage
verification: Run cd apps/web && npm run build and confirm no errors
Login and navigate to dashboard, verify all components load
Check API calls in browser DevTools include correct headers
findings: Successfully implemented FEAT-003. All requirements met: 1) Dashboard replaced with functional implementation using React hooks and API integration. 2) Header includes logo from /tood logo png.png, org name from /me endpoint, plan badge, and sign out button. 3) Trial banner reads from localStorage, shows countdown, links to /#pricing, redirects after 14 days. 4) Quick action buttons implemented with proper hrefs and API calls. 5) Recent tenders list fetches from /api/tenders with Bearer token. 6) Stats row shows counts from API data. 7) /me endpoint integration with 401 redirect handling. 8) Comprehensive error handling for network and API failures. Build completed successfully with no errors.
